dates.source_snapshot: Retrieved snapshots are not represented as publication-day archives.

unknowns_accepted.note: M1 8GPU official2.6TFLOPS retained with unspecified input/accumulator/sparsity; other unqualified numbers or relative multipliers not fabricated into precision peaks.
No inference from later generation approximate ratios.
Whole-machine wall power and adapter watts not GPU TDP.
Official historical and announced configurations included by original requirement; no current stock claim.

acceptance_boundary: Original GPU-bin/memory configuration scope is retained, not reduced to26 representative rows. Six Mac product lines cross-checked. No evidence-backed missing GPU/capacity combination remains in this reviewed corpus.
GPU, Neural Engine and GPU Neural Accelerator are distinct execution resources; unknown input/accumulator/sparsity peaks are valid completed source-review outcomes.
Equal chip/GPU/memory across hosts is deduplicated; CPU-bin/SSD/color/region SKU enumeration and measured sustained performance are separate questions.
M4Ultra and M6Pro/Max/Ultra have no verified official configuration in this audit; no guessed rows. This is not a claim that Apple has never disclosed them or that future products cannot appear.
New official product configurations or edits to referenced Apple records/sources require re-review; other vendors do not invalidate these subset digests.
